title: Field Operations Dashboard and Streamlined Cloud Sync
notes: Replaces the development-style landing screen with a field operations dashboard.
Adds account, connection, Continue, document-type, recent-cloud-document, and update sections with clearer visual hierarchy.
Allows a recent cloud Shot Diagram or Drill Log to be opened directly from Home with the existing recovery safeguard.
Centers Cloud Sync on one Sync Now action and a clearer current-document comparison.
Moves device naming, manual upload, Undo Cloud Download, contract details, and cloud deletion into advanced or overflow controls.
Preserves the verified m40.6.2 laptop and iPad edit layouts, touch routing, role permissions, document identity, header preservation, rotation, and conflict safeguards.
